description: How TmModelPicker groups its list. Grouping is a reading aid, never a filter: every supplied model stays reachable in exactly one group, and a model that does not report the property the list is grouped by lands in the localized Other group instead of disappearing.

members.name: None
members.description: One flat list, no group headers.

members.name: Provider
members.description: Grouped by AiModelInfo.Provider — the vendor or gateway the model is called through. The default.

members.name: Family
members.description: Grouped by AiModelInfo.Family — the model generation or line ("GPT-4", "Claude 3.5").
